Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the comparison logic by treating a smaller birth year as indicating a younger director. With correct birth dates (Curtis Bernhardt: 1899; Emile Ardolino: 1943), the Planner concluded Bernhardt was younger and selected "Torments of the Night," reversing the correct logic that a later birth year (1943) means younger, so the correct film is "Dirty Dancing."
